stories.title: Trust & First Resonances: Soren of Whisperleaf
stories.narrative_hook: Soren of Whisperleaf invites you to a quiet duel to assess your personal tactical philosophy.

objectives.description: Visit Soren of Whisperleaf at their preferred district and share a discussion.
Win a sparring duel using cards aligned with verdant pact.

stories.title: The Crucible of Conviction: Soren of Whisperleaf
stories.narrative_hook: A crisis in verdant pact territory threatens Soren of Whisperleaf's standing; they request your aid in an urgent joint trial.

objectives.description: Travel to the regional landmark associated with Soren of Whisperleaf.
Complete a 2v2 Tag challenge fighting shoulder-to-shoulder with Soren of Whisperleaf.

rewards.companion_tag_passive_unlocked: Verdant Symbiosis: Allied creatures heal +1 upon entering lane.

stories.title: The Unbroken Accord: Soren of Whisperleaf
stories.narrative_hook: Soren of Whisperleaf stands at a fateful crossroads. Together, you forge an eternal bond that permanently cements their partnership.

objectives.description: Overcome the ultimate ideological rival duel challenging Soren of Whisperleaf's legacy.
Present a custom attuned master card to seal your lifelong allegiance.
